semiconductor_relevance: High — QRT INC. provides critical testing and analysis services that enhance the quality and reliability of semiconductor components.
summary: QRT INC. offers comprehensive testing and analysis services for electronic components in the semiconductor industry, focusing on reliability evaluation and defect analysis. Their advanced services include non-destructive, electrical, structural, and chemical analysis, with specialized equipment like the SSD RDT Evaluation System for PCIe Gen4/5.
capabilities: SSD RDT Evaluation System for PCIe Gen4/5

regional_presence.United States: QRT INC. has established subsidiaries in Silicon Valley to expand its global sales network and local business.
